snippet.title: Shengui Diguo Zhi Emo Cheng GBC 神鬼帝國の惡魔城 32:33
snippet.description:
Shengui Diguo Zhi Emo Cheng Game Boy Color speedrun in 32:33

The Demon Castle of the Gods and Demons Empire. Known also as E Mo Cheng / Castlevania: Demon Castle. Original version of Sintax's Castlevania game, there is a DX version known as E Mo Cheng DX / Castlevania DX which was fan translated to English but I ran the original. A Metroidvania style game that the official Game Boy Castlevania games did not have. Sintax also made a sequel E Mo Dao which follows Getsu Fuma Den's playstyle .

Music tracks are taken from Belmont's Revenge. I used this route to try and take advantage of the heal/shop guys throughout the game. You have to rely of good item drops to increase your attack stat to defeat bosses faster. I had just over 20 attack but this can be over 30 with the best item drops if lucky. I made a map below, you will see 12 Keys but you only need to collect 11 as the final door is automatically unlocked after beating all the other bosses.

MAP: https://imgur.com/a/uMrZRP6

Played on BizHawk

Come see me live sometimes https://www.twitch.tv/rayquaza911
